subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as an advisory mitigation layer for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but install-time probing, a new environment surface, and overlap with update-CLI warning behavior are operator-experience choices automation cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, while leaving the stale-gateway issue open for complete recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from a real package update or rollback with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Pause For One Recovery Layer
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want update CLI output or runtime stale-import handling to be the only warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, while leaving the stale-gateway issue open for complete recovery behavior.
